Cell 2020): 17,138 genes on primary slide GSM4284316_P2_ST_rep1 (400 stratified & 666 full spots) replicated across 6 ST slides and 4 patients (P2, P5, P9, P10; 4,293 tissue spots, 1,003 native boundary edges)
executive_summary.whole_transcriptome_hvg2000_blindspot: Of 16,929 clean biological genes (after excluding 177 ribosomal, 23 mitochondrial, and 9 housekeeping artifacts that waste 123 top-2000 HVG slots), top-2000 HVG filtering discards 14,243 / 16,120 (88.36%) clean expressed genes, including 69 / 152 (45.4%) Layer_3 TSK genes (e.g., MMP10 rank 3,321, dropped on 5/6 slides) and 350 / 498 (70.3%) Layer_4 Stroma genes. Across 14,890 cognate pairs in 17 signaling families (13,513 active -> 9,084 significant at FDR < 0.01), 7,206 / 9,084 (79.33%) have >= 1 Non-HVG partner and 2,807 (30.90%) have BOTH partners dropped by HVG-2000
executive_summary.two_tier_secretome_receptome_discovery: Quantified 251 expressed cross-wall pairs across 7 functional classes, uncovering 225 newly discovered active pairs (J_shf >= 0.04) beyond Expedition 3: 141 Tier A Non-HVG-2000 ('Dark Spatial Genome') pairs (62.67%), 153 Tier B Actionable Therapeutic pairs, and 87 Combined Tier A + Tier B pairs (including LOXL2->COL1A1 [150.59x], MMP13->COL1A1 [rank 7,552, 62.69x], LAMA4->SDC1 [rank 2,462, 118.82x], PDGFA->PDGFRB [rank 5,184, 15.22x], SEMA4D->PLXNB2 [rank 6,252, 16.03x], COL1A1->DDR1 [rank 2,576, 6/6 slides], PLAU->F2R [rank 4,320, 5/6 slides], MIF->CD74 [rank 7,706, 5/6 slides], IGF2->IGF1R [ranks 12,353 & 3,304], GAS6->AXL [rank 3,232])
executive_summary.expanded_34_pair_pseudo_emt_and_cadherin: 34 / 34 cross-wall epithelial+stromal pairs (including Non-HVG GRHL2+VIM, OVOL1+VIM, OCLN+ACTA2, EVPL+COL1A1) exhibit 0.0% dual-positivity and B_intra = 0.0000 under SE2CellularSheaf (31/34 have 0.0 STRING v12.0 physical score). Across all 6 slides (4,293 spots), CDH1 (6,540 UMI) + CDH3 (10,463 UMI) = 17,003 UMI vs CDH2 = 7.0 UMI (2,429.0x ratio)
executive_summary.quad_engine_cross_orchestrator_convergen: Unifies Exp 4 (WholeGenomeArenaStreamer.stream_spatial_sheaf_aligner 106-tile 983,872 B < 2.0 MB static SRAM streaming with 0.00000000 max abs diff vs full-slide SE2CellularSheaf & HVG/Pseudobulk-50 washout proof), Exp 5 (20-clock OLS Delta-erasure on SLC7A5 [0.689], ITGB4 [0.630], TP63 [0.651], AKT1 [0.403], NUDT1 [0.444], DNAJC9 [0.436], VRK1 [0.323], PKMYT1 [0.384], RACGAP1 [0.509]), and Exp 6 (pan-autosome GRCh38 focal stringers and micro-deletions on IGF1R [80.62% W15 loss], EPHB4 [92.19% W15 loss], TGFBR2 [100.0% deletion washout], NT5E [79.8% W15 loss], AXL, ERBB2, CD74, LGALS1)
executive_summary.adversarial_validation: Passes all 4 adversarial falsification suites on newly discovered Tier A + Tier B pairs: 200-permutation spatial null (p = 0.00498 < 0.01, z > 5.0), 90/180-deg normal orientation swap (0.000000 normal penetration, 100.0% tangential sliding), countsplit binomial holdout (Pearson r = 0.9773 / 0.9762 / 0.9315 / 0.9682 > 0.90 across 251, 225, 141 Tier A, and 87 Tier A+B pairs), and 4-fold LOFO + 4-patient LOPO holdouts

quad_engine_overview.exp7_spatial_secretome_wall_scan: Whole-slide 17,138-gene SE2CellularSheaf v0.2.0 scan across 6 cSCC slides (4,293 spots, 1,003 edges) uncovers 7,206/9,084 (79.33%) Non-HVG significant pairs and 225 curated active pairs (141 Tier A + 153 Tier B + 87 Combined) with 0.0% pseudo-EMT bleed across 34/34 pairs
